notes.title: Update 2.7.9
notes.content:
[b]New UI elements[/b]

This update includes our third part of the UI remake. 

[b]The following elements have been remade:[/b]
[list]
[*] Markers
[*] NPC Dialogues
[*] Home storage
[*] Home menu
[*] Weapon swap
[*] Console
[*] PVP action bar
[*] Think and chat bubbles
[/list]

[b]More:[/b]
[list]
[*] Update: Translations
[*] Tweak: Slowdown upon attack
[*] Fix: XP bar progress
[*] Fix: Missing floating numbers on XP update
[*] Fix: Defeat impulse FX when using clubs
[*] Fix: Loot spawning at Cannon Island
[*] Fix: Loot spawning at Alien Beach
[*] Fix: Inventory section size refresh
[*] Fix: Respawning with current weapon
[*] Fix: Animation when acquiring a new weapon out of sync.
[*] Fix: Easy chair sit nodes
[*] Fix: Unique items that cannot be picked up should be shown as transparent
[*] Fix: Going to navigator while chatting making user stuck
[*] Fix: Bugs around the NPC Shop
[*] Fix: Bugs around think and chat bubbles
[*] Fix: Bugs around interaction markers
[*] Fix: Bugs around creature markers (meter, name)
[*] Fix: Bugs around home storage
[*] Add: Quest area circle (experimental feature)
[/list]

[b]About the local player marker:[/b]
The local player (you) do not have any visible marker anymore. If you want to see your name and title, have a look at your profile.

[b]About the interaction markers:[/b]
The "Press F to pick up" text is now replaced by a small interaction widget that become visible when you can interact with something. The arrow above items on the ground is also replaced with an outline around the object.

[b]About slowdown:[/b]
When attacking, your avatar will move slower for a short amount of time. There has been some changes to these values. In the arena, all weapons will slow down your movement by 50% when attacking. In normal play, ranged weapons will only slow down your movement by 10% instead.

notes.title: Update 2.7.7
notes.content:
[b]New UI system[/b]

We started working on a new UI system that will make the whole game faster and easier to maintain and extend. A lot of bugs will be auto-solved as we replace more parts of the old UI. Parts that are ready now are the HUD, the Esc-menu and the options menu.

While developing this new UI system, we also had to implement some improved ways of keeping states in sync, triggering and reacting to events, playing audio, loading assets, handling player input and handling localization.

Players might not notice much difference at this stage besides smoother UI animations, less overhead and a new chat and menu layout.

[b]Camera updates:[/b]
Classic platformer -> Platformer
MMORPG -> Classic
MMORPG (a version of MMORPG that is more responsive)

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some weapons use default color after level switch
[*] Some creatures stay red after taking damage
[*] Fiends look strange when defeated
[*] Faded ability bar
[*] Friend list black box
[*] Hide QuestLog/Bag/Profile while in another UI app (navigator/town/etc)
[*] Hero potion hearts display
[*] Invisible room icon in storage
[*] Bugs in town shaders
[*] FX overdrive on remote players (when other players use potions, the limit of effects running at the same time are ignored)
[*] Heart aura low emission rate
[*] Heart rocket duration
[*] Ghost in the Jar and hat combination
[*] Strange Legendary Wand problem (when two players have it)
[*] Player can climb ladders after being defeated
[*] Player can use potions when defeated
[*] Getting stuck on dungeon door
[/list]

notes.content:

[list]
[*] Beta support for GamePad!
[*] Emotes on special pickup reintroduced!
[*] Travel & Group update/fix
[*] Missing icon in notification fix
[*] Connection fixes
[*] Small updates around the camera
[/list]

[h3]GamePad support (beta)[/h3]
Did you ever wonder how it would be to play MilMo using a controller? Support for using a controller has been developed and is included in this update!
Here are some details:

[table]
[tr]
[th]Key[/th][th]Action[/th]
[/tr][tr]
[td]Left stick[/td][td]Move around[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td]Right stick[/td][td]Move camera[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td]2/A/Cross[/td][td]Jump[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td]1/X/Square[/td][td]Attack[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td]4/Y/Triangle[/td][td]Use/Talk[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td]3/B/Circle[/td][td]Toggle GUI pointer[/td]
[/tr][tr]
[td]Left shoulder (5/L1) & Right shoulder (6/R1)[/td][td]Swap weapon[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]

[b]Known limits in GUI-controller-mode for now:[/b]
- It's not possible to use toggle-boxes and scroll
- It's not possible to reach the "Esc-Menu"

[b]Tested with:[/b]
Logitech Rumblepad 2
